package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

type JobRepository struct{ Pool *pgxpool.Pool }

func (repository JobRepository) Ensure(ctx context.Context, job domain.PlanningJob) (domain.PlanningJob, bool, error) {
	requestJSON, err := json.Marshal(job.Request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PlanningJob{}, false, err
	}
	command, err := repository.Pool.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO tz_authoring_job(id,idempotency_key,request_hash,request_json,status,attempts,failure_code,created_at,updated_at)
VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,0,'',$6,$6)
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING`, job.ID, job.IdempotencyKey, job.RequestHash, requestJSON, job.Status, job.CreatedAt)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PlanningJob{}, false, err
	}
	stored, err := repository.getByIdempotencyKey(ctx, job.IdempotencyKey)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PlanningJob{}, false, err
	}
	if stored.RequestHash != job.RequestHash {
		return domain.PlanningJob{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return stored, command.RowsAffected() == 1, nil
}

func (repository JobRepository) Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (domain.PlanningJob, error) {
	return scanJob(repository.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, selectJob+` WHERE id=$1`, id))
}

func (repository JobRepository) getByIdempotencyKey(ctx context.Context, key string) (domain.PlanningJob, error) {
	return scanJob(repository.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, selectJob+` WHERE idempotency_key=$1`, key))
}

func (repository JobRepository) Claim(ctx context.Context, id, token string, now time.Time, lease time.Duration) (domain.PlanningJob, error) {
	expires := now.Add(lease)
	job, err := scanJob(repository.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
UPDATE tz_authoring_job
SET status='GENERATING',attempts=attempts+1,lease_token=$2,lease_expires_at=$3,failure_code='',updated_at=$4
WHERE id=$1 AND attempts<5 AND status NOT IN ('READY','STAGED')
  AND (status IN ('PLANNED','FAILED') OR lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at<=$4)
RETURNING id::text,idempotency_key::text,request_hash,request_json,status,attempts,
          COALESCE(lease_token::text,''),lease_expires_at,artifact_json,publication_json,staging_json,failure_code,created_at,updated_at`, id, token, expires, now))
	if err == nil {
		return job, nil
	}
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.PlanningJob{}, err
	}
	stored, getErr := repository.Get(ctx, id)
	if getErr != nil {
		return domain.PlanningJob{}, getErr
	}
	if stored.Status == domain.JobStatusReady || stored.Status == domain.JobStatusStaged {
		return stored, nil
	}
	if stored.Attempts >= 5 {
		return domain.PlanningJob{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return domain.PlanningJob{}, domain.ErrLeaseHeld
}

func (repository JobRepository) RenewLease(ctx context.Context, id, token string, now time.Time, lease time.Duration) error {
	return repository.updateClaimed(ctx, `UPDATE tz_authoring_job
SET lease_expires_at=$3,updated_at=$4
WHERE id=$1 AND lease_token=$2 AND status IN ('GENERATING','VERIFYING')`, id, token, now.Add(lease), now)
}

func (repository JobRepository) MarkVerifying(ctx context.Context, id, token string, now time.Time) error {
	return repository.updateClaimed(ctx, `UPDATE tz_authoring_job SET status='VERIFYING',updated_at=$3 WHERE id=$1 AND lease_token=$2`, id, token, now)
}

func (repository JobRepository) SaveReady(ctx context.Context, id, token string, artifact domain.AuthoringArtifact, now time.Time) error {
	artifactJSON, err := json.Marshal(artifact)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return repository.updateClaimed(ctx, `UPDATE tz_authoring_job SET status='READY',artifact_json=$3,failure_code='',lease_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,updated_at=$4 WHERE id=$1 AND lease_token=$2`, id, token, artifactJSON, now)
}

func (repository JobRepository) SaveStaging(ctx context.Context, id string, staging domain.StagingReceiptV1, now time.Time) error {
	stagingJSON, err := json.Marshal(staging)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	command, err := repository.Pool.Exec(ctx, "UPDATE tz_authoring_job SET status='STAGED',staging_json=$2,updated_at=$3 WHERE id=$1 AND status IN ('READY','STAGED') AND artifact_json IS NOT NULL AND publication_json IS NULL AND (staging_json IS NULL OR staging_json=$2::jsonb)", id, stagingJSON, now)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return nil
}

func (repository JobRepository) SaveFailed(ctx context.Context, id, token, failureCode string, now time.Time) error {
	return repository.updateClaimed(ctx, `UPDATE tz_authoring_job SET status='FAILED',artifact_json=NULL,failure_code=$3,lease_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,updated_at=$4 WHERE id=$1 AND lease_token=$2`, id, token, failureCode, now)
}

func (repository JobRepository) updateClaimed(ctx context.Context, query string, arguments ...any) error {
	command, err := repository.Pool.Exec(ctx, query, arguments...)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return nil
}

const selectJob = `SELECT id::text,idempotency_key::text,request_hash,request_json,status,attempts,
COALESCE(lease_token::text,''),lease_expires_at,artifact_json,publication_json,staging_json,failure_code,created_at,updated_at FROM tz_authoring_job`

type rowScanner interface{ Scan(...any) error }

func scanJob(row rowScanner) (domain.PlanningJob, error) {
	var job domain.PlanningJob
	var requestJSON, artifactJSON, publicationJSON, stagingJSON []byte
	var leaseExpiresAt *time.Time
	err := row.Scan(&job.ID, &job.IdempotencyKey, &job.RequestHash, &requestJSON, &job.Status, &job.Attempts, &job.LeaseToken, &leaseExpiresAt, &artifactJSON, &publicationJSON, &stagingJSON, &job.FailureCode, &job.CreatedAt, &job.UpdatedAt)
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.PlanningJob{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PlanningJob{}, err
	}
	job.LeaseExpiresAt = leaseExpiresAt
	job.LegacyPublicationPresent = len(publicationJSON) > 0 && string(publicationJSON) != "null"
	if err := json.Unmarshal(requestJSON, &job.Request); err != nil {
		return domain.PlanningJob{}, err
	}
	if len(artifactJSON) > 0 && string(artifactJSON) != "null" {
		var artifact domain.AuthoringArtifact
		if err := json.Unmarshal(artifactJSON, &artifact); err != nil {
			return domain.PlanningJob{}, err
		}
		job.Artifact = &artifact
	}
	if len(stagingJSON) > 0 && string(stagingJSON) != "null" {
		var staging domain.StagingReceiptV1
		if err := json.Unmarshal(stagingJSON, &staging); err != nil {
			return domain.PlanningJob{}, err
		}
		job.Staging = &staging
	}
	return job, nil
}

var _ domain.JobRepository = JobRepository{}
